def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    # build maps
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n['id']: [] for n in nodes}
    root_id = None
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is None:
            root_id = n['id']
        else:
            children[pid].append(n['id'])
    # all ids
    all_ids = list(node_map.keys())
    # compute initial symbol counts for required symbols
    symbol_count = {}
    for sym in required_symbols:
        count = sum(1 for n in nodes if n['symbol'] == sym)
        symbol_count[sym] = count
    # sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    removed_set = set()
    removed_order = []
    # function to get all retained descendants of a node (including itself)
    def get_subtree_ids(node_id, removed_set):
        subtree = set()
        stack = [node_id]
        while stack:
            nid = stack.pop()
            if nid in removed_set:
                continue  # already removed, skip
            subtree.add(nid)
            stack.extend(children[nid])
        return subtree

    for node_info in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node_info['id']
        if nid in removed_set:
            continue
        if nid == root_id:
            continue
        if not node_info['removable']:
            continue
        # get subtree
        subtree_ids = get_subtree_ids(nid, removed_set)
        # check if all nodes in subtree are removable (excluding root)
        can_remove = True
        for sid in subtree_ids:
            if not node_map[sid]['removable']:
                can_remove = False
                break
        if not can_remove:
            continue
        # compute symbol counts in subtree for required symbols
        subtree_sym_count = {}
        for sym in required_symbols:
            cnt = sum(1 for sid in subtree_ids if node_map[sid]['symbol'] == sym)
            subtree_sym_count[sym] = cnt
        # check if removing would eliminate any required symbol
        feasible = True
        for sym in required_symbols:
            if subtree_sym_count[sym] == symbol_count[sym]:
                feasible = False
                break
        if feasible:
            # remove subtree
            removed_set.update(subtree_ids)
            # update symbol counts
            for sym in required_symbols:
                symbol_count[sym] -= subtree_sym_count[sym]
            removed_order.append(nid)
    retained = sorted(all_ids - removed_set)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_order, "retained_node_ids": retained}
